Priya: Heads up — onboarding customer 'Titanium' LoRA merge hit a small regression after int4 quant.
Sam: repro steps?
Priya: quick summary: merged adapter v2 onto base titan-13B-std, then quantized to int4 with our opt-stat pipeline. Quick eval pack on 120 prompts.
Priya: metrics: fp16 perplexity 12.3, int4 perplexity 13.8 (+12%), answer-exact-match dropped 0.9 pts (91.1 → 90.2) on QA set.
Sam: can you paste the eval command and diff?
Priya: sure:
```
run_eval --model titan-13b+ti-lora-v2 --quant int4 --prompts evalpacks/titanium_basic.yaml --batch 4 --kv-cache 32
```
Priya: diff snippet (int4 vs fp16):
```
- Q: What's the refund policy?\nA: Refunds processed within 7 days.\n+ Q: What's the refund policy?\nA: Refunds processed within 72 hours.
```
Jordan: sounds like tokenizer detokenization drift or beam search instability. Any tokenization changes in the adapter?
Priya: Adapter uses same tokenizer; suspect weight merging scaling during int4 fp-map. I noticed higher logit variance on some tokens.
Kai: try rerunning with per-channel scaling and the mixed-quant fallback for attention kernels, also run with smaller temperature for generation check.
Priya: running that now, will post results.
(eval-bot): Eval run 1759801290 completed — 120 prompts. FP16 EM 91.1, INT4 EM 90.2, INT4+perchscale EM 90.9. Latency int4 ~ 18ms/token, fp16 ~28ms/token.
Nina: if int4+perchscale recovers to within 0.5 pts we're ok for canary. Define rollout: start on dedicated, 1% traffic, monitor EM and latency. @Sam @Kai to prepare canary config.
Sam: on it. I'll add a rollback policy and threshold alerts.
Priya: thanks — saving artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/titanium/1759801290/
Kai: FYI I added a small checklist in the PR: quant-sanity, tokenizer-check, smoke-sample. Link: https://git.repo/infra/titanium/lora-pr-542
Jordan: nice. if it resurfaces we'll try 4-bit with outlier clipping.
Nina: cool. closing for now unless further regressions. :thumbsup:
